# EnterpriseGlue v0.19.2 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.19.1`.

## Highlights

- **release-automation:** Keeps release charts synchronized with managed OSS versions and verifies repeat Helm packages by canonical payload so chart publication cannot fail after container promotion.

## User and administrator impact

- Release operators receive a signed host chart whose default application version matches the corresponding published OSS containers.
- Plugin-toolchain chart publication accepts archives with identical files and permissions even when Helm changes non-semantic package timestamps.
- EnterpriseGlue 0.19.2 fixes forward from the 0.19.1 host-chart publication failure without changing application behavior.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Use the host chart published with the matching OSS release and keep backend and frontend images pinned to the digests recorded by that release.

## Database migrations

- This packaging correction does not change database schemas, migrations, or rollback windows.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Release preparation derives the next chart patch from the previous immutable release tag and binds appVersion to the managed OSS release version.
- Repeat plugin-chart packages are compared with the existing path-safe canonical archive validator, which rejects content, permissions, link-target, duplicate-path, and path-traversal differences while ignoring packaging timestamps.
- The protected workflow continues to require exact source tags, signatures, reproducible archives, immutable OCI subjects, smoke tests, and vulnerability gates.

## Documentation

- The versioned release notes identify the corrected host-chart publication and the exact compatible OSS application release.

## Known limitations

- The v0.19.1 application containers are valid, signed, scanned, and smoke-tested, but its host-chart workflow did not publish a matching chart and its plugin-toolchain chart lane stopped on non-semantic Helm archive timestamps; v0.19.2 is the deployable fix-forward release unit.

## Rollback

- Roll back to a previously published chart together with its matching immutable backend and frontend image digests; do not combine a chart with a different application release unless explicitly qualified.

## Validation evidence

- Reproduce the v0.19.1 protected host-chart failure caused by appVersion 0.19.0 not matching release v0.19.1.
- Reproduce the Helm 3.19 raw-hash mismatch across otherwise identical plugin-chart packages and verify canonical comparison accepts metadata-only timestamp differences while rejecting payload and archive-safety differences.
- Run release-note and chart-version synchronization unit tests, host-chart validation, release-policy contracts, and the release-candidate readiness lane.
- Publish the fix-forward patch through the protected hotfix workflow and verify the signed OCI chart receipt against the exact release commit.

## Release metadata

- Release-note fragments: `host-chart-release-version-sync`
- Audiences: operators, developers
- Compatibility: backward-compatible
